mapper.select: SELECT prs.id, prs.sku_id AS skuId, owner_pd.sku_no AS skuNo, owner_pd.variant_property AS variantProperty, prs.ref_sku_id AS refSkuId, ref_pd.sku_no AS refSkuNo, ref_pd.name AS refProductName, prs.remark, prs.sort FROM product_ref_sku prs LEFT JOIN product_detail owner_pd ON owner_pd.id = prs.sku_id AND owner_pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_detail ref_pd ON ref_pd.id = prs.ref_sku_id AND ref_pd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE prs.is_deleted = FALSE AND prs.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY COALESCE(prs.sort, 0), prs.create_time, prs.id

SELECT prs.id, prs.sku_id AS skuId, owner_pd.sku_no AS skuNo, owner_pd.variant_property AS variantProperty, prs.ref_sku_id AS refSkuId, ref_pd.sku_no AS refSkuNo, ref_pd.name AS refProductName, prs.remark, prs.sort FROM product_ref_sku prs LEFT JOIN product_detail owner_pd ON owner_pd.id = prs.sku_id AND owner_pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_detail ref_pd ON ref_pd.id = prs.ref_sku_id AND ref_pd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE prs.is_deleted = FALSE AND prs.sku_id = #{skuId} ORDER BY COALESCE(prs.sort, 0), prs.create_time, prs.id
